---
title: "Jeremiah"
---

# Jeremiah

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

Jeremiah calls Judah to repentance while announcing both coming judgment and the promise of a New Covenant. The book teaches that God's faithfulness endures despite His people's rebellion.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 1:5</div>

<div class="identifier">Before I formed thee in the womb I knew thee</div>

### Why This Verse

One of Jeremiah's most famous verses

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Jeremiah's call as a prophet. The key verse emphasizes God's sovereign purpose and commissioning of His servant.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 2:13</div>

<div class="identifier">Broken cisterns</div>

### Why This Verse

Powerful image of spiritual apostasy

### Chapter Insight

This chapter confronts Judah's spiritual adultery. The key verse highlights the tragedy of abandoning God, the source of living water.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 3:15</div>

<div class="identifier">Shepherds after Mine own heart</div>

### Why This Verse

Promise of godly leadership

### Chapter Insight

This chapter calls the nation to repentance despite persistent unfaithfulness. The key verse reveals God's willingness to restore the repentant.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 4:14</div>

<div class="identifier">Wash thine heart from wickedness</div>

### Why This Verse

Call to repentance

### Chapter Insight

This chapter warns of coming judgment from the north. The key verse urges genuine repentance rather than superficial religion.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 5:21</div>

<div class="identifier">Hear now this, O foolish people</div>

### Why This Verse

Spiritual blindness

### Chapter Insight

This chapter exposes Judah's widespread corruption. The key verse demonstrates that judgment comes when truth and righteousness are rejected.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 6

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 6:16</div>

<div class="identifier">Ask for the old paths</div>

### Why This Verse

Frequently quoted call to faithfulness

### Chapter Insight

This chapter warns of Jerusalem's impending destruction. The key verse calls God's people to seek the ancient paths of righteousness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 7

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 7:23</div>

<div class="identifier">Obey My voice</div>

### Why This Verse

Covenant obedience

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains Jeremiah's Temple Sermon. The key verse warns against trusting religious rituals while neglecting obedience.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 8

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 8:22</div>

<div class="identifier">Is there no balm in Gilead?</div>

### Why This Verse

One of Jeremiah's most quoted questions

### Chapter Insight

This chapter laments Judah's refusal to repent. The key verse highlights the people's rejection of God's wisdom.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 9

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 9:23</div>

<div class="identifier">Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom</div>

### Why This Verse

True grounds for boasting

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contrasts human boasting with knowing God. The key verse teaches that true glory is found in understanding and knowing the Lord.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 10

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 10:23</div>

<div class="identifier">The way of man is not in himself</div>

### Why This Verse

Dependence on God

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contrasts the living God with idols. The key verse proclaims God's uniqueness and sovereignty over creation.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 11

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 11:8</div>

<div class="identifier">They obeyed not, nor inclined their ear</div>

### Why This Verse

Covenant rebellion

### Chapter Insight

This chapter addresses Judah's violation of the covenant. The key verse emphasizes the consequences of covenant unfaithfulness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 12

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 12:5</div>

<div class="identifier">If thou hast run with the footmen</div>

### Why This Verse

Perseverance under greater trials

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Jeremiah's questions about God's justice. The key verse encourages perseverance despite difficult circumstances.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 13

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 13:23</div>

<div class="identifier">Can the Ethiopian change his skin?</div>

### Why This Verse

Human inability to reform itself

### Chapter Insight

This chapter uses symbolic actions to illustrate Judah's pride. The key verse reveals that pride prevents people from honoring God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 14

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 14:9</div>

<div class="identifier">Yet Thou, O LORD, art in the midst of us</div>

### Why This Verse

Appeal for mercy

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records prayers during a devastating drought. The key verse emphasizes dependence upon God as the only true source of hope.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 15

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 15:16</div>

<div class="identifier">Thy words were found, and I did eat them</div>

### Why This Verse

Beloved verse on God's Word

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains God's response to Jeremiah's complaints. The key verse calls for faithful endurance in ministry.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 16

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 16:19</div>

<div class="identifier">O LORD, my strength and my fortress</div>

### Why This Verse

Hope among the nations

### Chapter Insight

This chapter portrays the severity of coming judgment. The key verse points beyond judgment to future restoration.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 17

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 17:9</div>

<div class="identifier">The heart is deceitful above all things</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most cited verses in Jeremiah

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contrasts trusting in humanity with trusting in God. The key verse describes the blessing of placing confidence in the Lord.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 18

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 18:6</div>

<div class="identifier">As the clay is in the potter's hand</div>

### Why This Verse

One of Jeremiah's defining images

### Chapter Insight

This chapter presents the potter and the clay. The key verse emphasizes God's sovereign right to shape nations and individuals.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 19

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 19:11</div>

<div class="identifier">So will I break this people</div>

### Why This Verse

Symbolic judgment

### Chapter Insight

This chapter uses a broken vessel to symbolize Judah's coming destruction. The key verse illustrates the consequences of persistent rebellion.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 20

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 20:9</div>

<div class="identifier">His word was in mine heart as a burning fire</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous description of prophetic calling

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Jeremiah's persecution and discouragement. The key verse reveals the irresistible power of God's word within His servant.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 21

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 21:8</div>

<div class="identifier">I set before you the way of life and death</div>

### Why This Verse

Choice and accountability

### Chapter Insight

This chapter announces Jerusalem's unavoidable judgment. The key verse calls people to choose the path of life through submission to God's purposes.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 22

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 22:29</div>

<div class="identifier">O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Dramatic prophetic appeal

### Chapter Insight

This chapter addresses Judah's kings and leaders. The key verse emphasizes justice, righteousness, and care for the vulnerable.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 23

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 23:29</div>

<div class="identifier">Is not My word like a fire?</div>

### Why This Verse

One of Jeremiah's most quoted verses

### Chapter Insight

This chapter condemns false shepherds and promises a righteous King. The key verse points to the coming Messiah, the righteous Branch.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 24

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 24:7</div>

<div class="identifier">I will give them a heart to know Me</div>

### Why This Verse

Promise of restoration

### Chapter Insight

This chapter uses the vision of good and bad figs. The key verse distinguishes those whom God will restore from those facing judgment.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 25

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 25:11</div>

<div class="identifier">These nations shall serve Babylon seventy years</div>

### Why This Verse

Key exile prophecy

### Chapter Insight

This chapter summarizes Jeremiah's message and predicts seventy years of exile. The key verse demonstrates God's sovereignty over nations and history.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 26

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 26:13</div>

<div class="identifier">Amend your ways and your doings</div>

### Why This Verse

Call to repentance

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records opposition to Jeremiah's preaching. The key verse highlights the courage required to proclaim God's truth faithfully.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 27

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 27:5</div>

<div class="identifier">I have made the earth</div>

### Why This Verse

God's sovereign authority

### Chapter Insight

This chapter uses a yoke to symbolize Babylon's dominance. The key verse calls the nations to submit to God's appointed discipline.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 28

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 28:9</div>

<div class="identifier">When the word of the prophet comes to pass</div>

### Why This Verse

Test of a true prophet

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contrasts true and false prophecy through Hananiah. The key verse emphasizes that God's word will ultimately prove true.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 29

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 29:11</div>

<div class="identifier">I know the plans I have for you</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most quoted verses in the Bible

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains Jeremiah's letter to the exiles. The key verse encourages trust in God's future plans despite present hardship.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 30

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 30:17</div>

<div class="identifier">I will restore health unto thee</div>

### Why This Verse

Restoration promise

### Chapter Insight

This chapter promises Israel's future restoration. The key verse points to God's covenant faithfulness beyond judgment.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 31

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 31:3</div>

<div class="identifier">I have loved thee with an everlasting love</div>

### Why This Verse

One of Jeremiah's greatest promises

### Chapter Insight

This chapter announces the New Covenant. The key verse promises God's law written upon the heart.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 32

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 32:17</div>

<div class="identifier">There is nothing too hard for Thee</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous declaration of faith

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Jeremiah's purchase of a field during the siege. The key verse demonstrates faith in God's promise of future restoration.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 33

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 33:3</div>

<div class="identifier">Call unto Me, and I will answer thee</div>

### Why This Verse

Widely quoted prayer promise

### Chapter Insight

This chapter promises the restoration of Jerusalem and David's line. The key verse reaffirms God's covenant with David and His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 34

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 34:15</div>

<div class="identifier">You had done right in My sight</div>

### Why This Verse

Covenant accountability

### Chapter Insight

This chapter condemns Judah's failure to honor its covenant obligations. The key verse highlights the seriousness of breaking promises before God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 35

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 35:19</div>

<div class="identifier">Jonadab shall not want a man to stand before Me</div>

### Why This Verse

Rechabite faithfulness rewarded

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contrasts Judah's disobedience with the faithfulness of the Rechabites. The key verse commends steadfast obedience.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 36

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 36:23</div>

<div class="identifier">The king cut it with a penknife</div>

### Why This Verse

Rejection of God's word

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the burning of Jeremiah's scroll. The key verse demonstrates that God's word cannot be destroyed by human opposition.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 37

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 37:17</div>

<div class="identifier">Is there any word from the LORD?</div>

### Why This Verse

Zedekiah's secret inquiry

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Jeremiah's imprisonment during Jerusalem's siege. The key verse highlights faithful proclamation despite rejection.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 38

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 38:6</div>

<div class="identifier">They cast Jeremiah into the dungeon</div>

### Why This Verse

One of Jeremiah's most memorable events

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Jeremiah's rescue from a cistern. The key verse emphasizes the cost of speaking God's truth.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 39

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 39:18</div>

<div class="identifier">Because thou hast put thy trust in Me</div>

### Why This Verse

Deliverance through faith

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes Jerusalem's fall. The key verse demonstrates the fulfillment of God's warnings through the prophets.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 40

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 40:4</div>

<div class="identifier">See, all the land is before thee</div>

### Why This Verse

Aftermath of Jerusalem's fall

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records events following Jerusalem's destruction. The key verse reveals God's continued care for a remnant.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 41

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 41:17</div>

<div class="identifier">They departed to go into Egypt</div>

### Why This Verse

Continued instability

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts the assassination of Gedaliah. The key verse illustrates the tragic consequences of political violence and distrust.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 42

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 42:6</div>

<div class="identifier">Whether it be good or evil, we will obey</div>

### Why This Verse

Promise later broken

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the people's request for guidance. The key verse highlights the importance of obeying God after seeking His will.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 43

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 43:7</div>

<div class="identifier">They obeyed not the voice of the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Rebellion continues

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes Judah's disobedient flight to Egypt. The key verse demonstrates the danger of rejecting God's clear direction.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 44

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 44:17</div>

<div class="identifier">We will certainly do whatsoever thing goes forth out of our own mouth</div>

### Why This Verse

Defiant apostasy

### Chapter Insight

This chapter rebukes continued idolatry in Egypt. The key verse reveals the persistence of rebellion despite judgment.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 45

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 45:5</div>

<div class="identifier">Seekest thou great things for thyself? Seek them not</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous personal admonition

### Chapter Insight

This chapter offers encouragement to Baruch. The key verse teaches contentment and trust amid difficult times.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 46

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 46:27</div>

<div class="identifier">Fear not, O Jacob My servant</div>

### Why This Verse

Hope amid judgment

### Chapter Insight

This chapter prophesies judgment against Egypt. The key verse demonstrates God's sovereignty over powerful nations.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 47

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 47:6</div>

<div class="identifier">O thou sword of the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Memorable prophetic image

### Chapter Insight

This chapter announces judgment upon the Philistines. The key verse emphasizes that no nation stands outside God's authority.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 48

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 48:10</div>

<div class="identifier">Cursed be he that doeth the work of the LORD deceitfully</div>

### Why This Verse

Frequently quoted warning

### Chapter Insight

This chapter pronounces judgment against Moab. The key verse warns against pride and self-confidence.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 49

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 49:16</div>

<div class="identifier">The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee</div>

### Why This Verse

Judgment on Edom

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains prophecies against several nations. The key verse demonstrates God's rule over all peoples and kingdoms.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 50

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 50:6</div>

<div class="identifier">My people have been lost sheep</div>

### Why This Verse

One of Jeremiah's most quoted metaphors

### Chapter Insight

This chapter foretells Babylon's downfall. The key verse reveals God's justice against oppressive empires.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 51

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 51:10</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD hath brought forth our righteousness</div>

### Why This Verse

Hope of vindication

### Chapter Insight

This chapter continues the prophecy of Babylon's destruction. The key verse assures that God will vindicate His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 52

<div class="key-verse">Jeremiah 52:31</div>

<div class="identifier">Evil-merodach lifted up the head of Jehoiachin</div>

### Why This Verse

Hopeful conclusion

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Jerusalem's fall and the exile. The key verse concludes the book by affirming the historical fulfillment of God's word while preserving hope through Jehoiachin's release.
:::
